heading: This Afternoon
text: Mostly sunny and unseasonably warm. Highs in the mid 70s, some upper 70s possible in the warmer valleys. South to southwest winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tonight
text: Clouds variable early, then increasing. Chance of showers late in New York. Lows from the upper 40s to mid 50s east of the Greens, mid 50s to around 60 west. South to southwest winds 5 to 10 mph, and gusting to 30 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Thursday
text: Partly to mostly cloudy. Showers likely, more so in the morning west of the Greens, and in the afternoon east. Highs mainly in the mid to upper 60s. South to southwest winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph in the Champlain Valley.
